verdict.rationale: DPMA is a patent and trade mark office offering online databases and filing services, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence covers only web databases, e-filing routes and desktop filing software, plus a robots.txt that disallows crawling. Nothing documents an official MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
